    24 *
  • {@code REGION} — the owner's region (derived from its postcode, falling back to its 25 * city);
    • 26 *
  • {@code FY} — the two-digit {@link FiscalYear fiscal year} the owner's registration date 27 * falls in (the fiscal year starts on 1 July);
    • 28 *
  • {@code HASH8} — the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the 29 * owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last name (the same value used by the 30 * region-and-hash identity);
    • 31 *
  • {@code CHK} — a single {@link Luhn} check digit over the digits of 32 * {@code }.
    • 33 *
34 * e.g. {@code "NSW261A2B3C4D9"}. A collision with an already-stored member id is 35 * de-duplicated by appending {@code -}; the fixed {@code FY}+{@code HASH8}+{@code CHK} 36 * tail lets the region and fiscal-year segments be read back regardless. 37 */ 38 public final class MemberId { 39 40 /** Number of leading hex characters of the identity hash kept in the member id. */ 41 private static final int HASH_LENGTH = 8; 42 43 /** Number of characters of the two-digit fiscal-year segment. */ 44 private static final int FY_LENGTH = 2; 45 46 /** Number of characters of the Luhn check-digit segment. */ 47 private static final int CHECK_LENGTH = 1; 48 49 /** Length of the fixed {@code FY}+{@code HASH8}+{@code CHK} tail that follows the region. */ 50 private static final int TAIL_LENGTH = FY_LENGTH + HASH_LENGTH + CHECK_LENGTH; 51 52 private MemberId() { 53 } 54 55 /** 56 * The member id for an owner in {@code region}, registered on {@code registrationDate}, 57 * with the given normalized {@code telephone} and {@code lastName}. This is the base 58 * value before any collision de-duplication. 59 * 60 * @param region the owner's region ({@code REGION} segment) 61 * @param registrationDate the owner's registration date (source of the {@code FY} segment) 62 * @param telephone the owner's normalized telephone (hashed into {@code HASH8}) 63 * @param lastName the owner's last name (hashed into {@code HASH8}) 64 * @return the formatted member id 65 */ 66 public static String of(String region, LocalDate registrationDate, String telephone, String lastName) { 67 String fiscalYear = String.format("%0" + FY_LENGTH + "d", FiscalYear.startYearOf(registrationDate) % 100); 68 String hash8 = Sha256Hex.prefix(telephone + lastName, HASH_LENGTH); 69 String body = region + fiscalYear + hash8; 70 return body + Luhn.checkDigit(body); 71 } 72 73 /** 74 * The {@code REGION} segment of {@code memberId}: everything before the fixed 75 * {@code FY}+{@code HASH8}+{@code CHK} tail, ignoring any {@code -} de-duplication 76 * suffix. 77 * 78 * @param memberId the member id to read 79 * @return its region segment 80 */ 81 public static String regionOf(String memberId) { 82 String core = stripSuffix(memberId); 83 return core.substring(0, core.length() - TAIL_LENGTH); 84 } 85 86 /** 87 * The two-digit {@code FY} (fiscal-year) segment of {@code memberId}, ignoring any 88 * {@code -} de-duplication suffix. 89 * 90 * @param memberId the member id to read 91 * @return its two-digit fiscal-year segment 92 */ 93 public static String fiscalYearOf(String memberId) { 94 String core = stripSuffix(memberId); 95 int start = core.length() - TAIL_LENGTH; 96 return core.substring(start, start + FY_LENGTH); 97 } 98 99 /** Strips the {@code -} de-duplication suffix, if any, leaving the formatted core. */ 100 private static String stripSuffix(String memberId) { 101 int dash = memberId.indexOf('-'); 102 return dash < 0 ? memberId : memberId.substring(0, dash); 103 } 104 } 105

23	/**
24	 * Detects, on create, whether a new owner duplicates an already-stored one. All duplicate
25	 * detection is consolidated into the owner's {@link Owner#getIdentityKey() identity key}
26	 * (a hash of the telephone, email and the last name's Soundex code): a candidate is a
27	 * duplicate only when an existing owner carries the exact same identity key. Because the
28	 * telephone is part of the key, owners that differ in any one of those parts — including two
29	 * members of the same household with different telephones — have distinct keys and are not
30	 * duplicates.
31	 */
32	@Component
33	public class IdentityDuplicateChecker {
34	
35	    private final ClinicService clinicService;
36	
37	    public IdentityDuplicateChecker(ClinicService clinicService) {
38	        this.clinicService = clinicService;
39	    }
40	
41	    /**
42	     * Reports whether an already-stored owner shares {@code candidate}'s identity key.
43	     *
44	     * @param candidate the owner being created, not yet stored
45	     * @return {@code true} when another owner already carries the same identity key
46	     */
47	    public boolean isDuplicate(Owner candidate) {
48	        String identityKey = candidate.getIdentityKey();
49	        return clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
50	            .filter(existing -> !existing.isDeleted())
51	            .anyMatch(existing -> existing.getIdentityKey().equals(identityKey));
52	    }
53	}

Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, the single value that identifies the owner, formatted
                as '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region derived from the owner's
                postcode (falling back to its city), FY is the two-digit fiscal year the
                registrationDate falls in (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with its last name, and CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned on create and
                de-duplicated against existing owners.
              type: string
              example: NSW261A2B3C4D9
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit FY segment carried by the owner's memberId. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                owner's memberId.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the memberId, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', derived on read
                from the owner's own fields. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on create when the owner joins
                an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' flag; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A2B7C1D0E
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of the owner's normalized telephone, lower-cased
                email and the Soundex code of its last name joined with '|' as
                'sha256(<telephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>)', with a missing telephone
                or email contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates (rejected on
                create) only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when supplied it is combined with
            the last name to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is
            ignored on input. On read it is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on
            create. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either
            form: a non-blank 'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create and, when present, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's ageBand relative to the registration date. Formatted as an ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the owner is not flagged
            as a possible duplicate even though another owner shares its last name and
            postcode. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, the single value that identifies the owner, formatted
                as '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region derived from the owner's
                postcode (falling back to its city), FY is the two-digit fiscal year the
                registrationDate falls in (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with its last name, and CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned on create and
                de-duplicated against existing owners.
              type: string
              example: NSW261A2B3C4D9
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit FY segment carried by the owner's memberId. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                owner's memberId.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the memberId, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', derived on read
                from the owner's own fields. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on create when the owner joins
                an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' flag; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A2B7C1D0E
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of the owner's normalized telephone, lower-cased
                email and the Soundex code of its last name joined with '|' as
                'sha256(<telephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>)', with a missing telephone
                or email contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates (rejected on
                create) only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3b8f2e1a9c7d4b6e0f5a2c8d1e4b7a0c3f6e9d2b5a8c1f4e7d0a3b6c9e2f5a8b'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. Derived on read from the
                owner's telephone, which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read from the owner's title and last
                name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title was supplied, or just the last
                name when it was not.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners already stored when this owner was created that
                share its first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's registration day was already busy when this owner was
                created: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on that day,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city was approaching its owner capacity when this owner
                was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the hard limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, when created, softly matched an already-stored owner: one
                whose lastName shares its Soundex code and whose postcode matches, while their
                identity keys differ. Assigned on create; when true, 'possibleDuplicateOf'
                identifies the matched owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the already-stored owner this owner softly matched on create
                (matching lastName Soundex and postcode, differing identity key). Present only
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner should be flagged for review: true when any risk signal
                holds — the owner is a possible duplicate, its email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (resembles a known throwaway provider without being on the
                blocklist), or its city was over soft capacity when created (its
                'capacityWarning' is set) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

          headers:

                type: string

              schema:
                type: string

          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when supplied it is combined with
            the last name to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is
            ignored on input. On read it is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on
            create. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either
            form: a non-blank 'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create and, when present, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's ageBand relative to the registration date. Formatted as an ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the owner is not flagged
            as a possible duplicate even though another owner shares its last name and
            postcode. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity representation. Always 2: the memberId,
                identityKey and householdId are grouped under the 'identity' object, and the
                region code carried inside those identifiers is derived with the version-2
                algorithm (a fixed 'V2' tag mixed in).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit FY segment carried by the owner's memberId. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                owner's memberId.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the memberId, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', derived on read
                from the owner's own fields. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on create when the owner joins
                an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' flag; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A2B7C1D0E
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of the owner's normalized telephone, lower-cased
                email and the Soundex code of its last name joined with '|' as
                'sha256(<telephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>)', with a missing telephone
                or email contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates (rejected on
                create) only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3b8f2e1a9c7d4b6e0f5a2c8d1e4b7a0c3f6e9d2b5a8c1f4e7d0a3b6c9e2f5a8b'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. Derived on read from the
                owner's telephone, which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read from the owner's title and last
                name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title was supplied, or just the last
                name when it was not.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners already stored when this owner was created that
                share its first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's registration day was already busy when this owner was
                created: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on that day,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city was approaching its owner capacity when this owner
                was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the hard limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, when created, softly matched an already-stored owner: one
                whose lastName shares its Soundex code and whose postcode matches, while their
                identity keys differ. Assigned on create; when true, 'possibleDuplicateOf'
                identifies the matched owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the already-stored owner this owner softly matched on create
                (matching lastName Soundex and postcode, differing identity key). Present only
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner should be flagged for review: true when any risk signal
                holds — the owner is a possible duplicate, its email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (resembles a known throwaway provider without being on the
                blocklist), or its city was over soft capacity when created (its
                'capacityWarning' is set) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

    OwnerPage:

        totalPages:

    PetFields:

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional client-supplied key that makes owner creation idempotent.
            Repeating a create with an already-seen key returns the originally
            created owner instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when supplied it is combined with
            the last name to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is
            ignored on input. On read it is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on
            create. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either
            form: a non-blank 'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create and, when present, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's ageBand relative to the registration date. Formatted as an ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the owner is not flagged
            as a possible duplicate even though another owner shares its last name and
            postcode. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity representation. Always 2: the memberId,
                identityKey and householdId are grouped under the 'identity' object, and the
                region code carried inside those identifiers is derived with the version-2
                algorithm (a fixed 'V2' tag mixed in).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit FY segment carried by the owner's memberId. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                owner's memberId.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the memberId, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', derived on read
                from the owner's own fields. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. Derived on read from the
                owner's telephone, which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read from the owner's title and last
                name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title was supplied, or just the last
                name when it was not.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners already stored when this owner was created that
                share its first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's registration day was already busy when this owner was
                created: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on that day,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city was approaching its owner capacity when this owner
                was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the hard limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, when created, softly matched an already-stored owner: one
                whose lastName shares its Soundex code and whose postcode matches, while their
                identity keys differ. Assigned on create; when true, 'possibleDuplicateOf'
                identifies the matched owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the already-stored owner this owner softly matched on create
                (matching lastName Soundex and postcode, differing identity key). Present only
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner should be flagged for review: true when any risk signal
                holds — the owner is a possible duplicate, its email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (resembles a known throwaway provider without being on the
                blocklist), or its city was over soft capacity when created (its
                'capacityWarning' is set) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:

lines: +        The values that identify an owner, grouped together. Under identity version 2 the
+        region code carried inside each is derived with a fixed 'V2' tag mixed in, so every
+        value differs from the version-1 value for the same owner.
+            The owner's member id, the single value that identifies the owner, formatted
+            as '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the version-2 region code (a fixed 'V2'
+            tag mixed into the region derived from the owner's postcode, falling back to its
+            city), FY is the two-digit fiscal year the registrationDate falls in (the fiscal
+            year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
+            SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last
+            name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
+            Assigned on create and de-duplicated against existing owners.
+            The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
+            lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of the fixed 'V2' version tag, the owner's normalized
+            telephone, lower-cased email and the Soundex code of its last name joined with '|'
+            telephone or email contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates
+            (rejected on create) only when their whole identity keys are equal.
+            Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same last
+            name and postcode), the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the fixed
+            'V2' version tag joined with the owner's normalized last name and postcode.
